messages:
Maya (CS): Hey team — quick status check for Bridgefold week0. They hit the preflight firewall and KMS questions this morning. I want to surface anything that looks like a renewal risk (latency/cost concerns) and make sure we have an ops runbook session scheduled.
Sam (SRE): I dug into the firewall logs. Their egress rules blocked our audit forwarding to their Splunk endpoint — I suggested adding the subnet CIDR + port 443.
Leo (Infra): Can you paste the exact rule you suggested? I can share the snippet to Ruth for corporate security.
Sam (SRE): Sure — snippet below:
```
allow tcp from 10.12.0.0/22 to 3.45.67.89:443 # redwood-audit-forwarding
```
Sam (SRE): Also noted they’re on an older NAT config which pushes some traffic through a proxy chain; that adds ~30-50ms tail latency for outbound audit calls. Not a platform SLO risk but flagged for customer expectation.
Ruth (Bridgefold): Thanks — we can add the rule. The proxy is managed by our infra team; I can escalate if the latency is a blocker. We do have a renewal conversation next month, want to avoid surprises.
Maya (CS): Good to know. Ruth — do you expect the proxy change to be quick if we request it?
Ruth (Bridgefold): Should be a 1–2 business day change once approved. I can request it today but I need the exact wording + justification.
Maya (CS): Copy — I’ll draft the justification, but Leo / Sam can you confirm the ask includes the audit endpoint + TLS only? We need an explicit allow list.
Leo (Infra): Confirmed: only 3.45.67.89:443, TLS 1.2+, and we will sign the payloads. Also KMS note: their BYOK key policy needs a different alias path than our examples. I left inline comments on the key policy doc.
Sam (SRE): KMS checklist we ran:
- Give us kms:Encrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey for the alias redwood/bridgefold-prod
- Add CloudTrail write to their central account for audit logs
I attached a CLI command they can run if they want to create the alias quickly.
Maya (CS): Can you paste the CLI so Ruth can forward?
Sam (SRE): CLI: `aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/redwood-bridgefold-prod --target-key-id <KEY_ID>`
Leo (Infra): For CloudTrail forwarding we recommended an S3 bucket in their logging account with a bucket policy to accept PutObject from our account id. Sample policy I dropped in the doc.
Ruth (Bridgefold): Ok — I’ll forward the firewall rule + KMS CLI to our infra lead. One more ask: we saw a token-based cost spike in your hosted logs on day -1 of testing. Anything we should be aware of? That’s the main renewal sensitivity.
Sam (SRE): That spike was during a long eval job hitting large seq lengths and no KV cache. We recommended enabling prefix caching and a 64-token max window for their initial smoke tests; that should drop token cost 40–60% for typical flows.
Maya (CS): Action items so far: 1) Ruth to escalate proxy/firewall change (Sam/Leo provide final snippets) 2) Ruth to run KMS alias CLI (Sam provided) 3) CS/Eng to schedule a 30m runbook walkthrough before the end of week.
Ruth (Bridgefold): I can do the runbook session Thursday 11am PT. Works for your teams?
Maya (CS): Thursday 11am PT works for me. Sam/Leo?
Leo (Infra): I’ll be there. I’ll bring the KMS policy diffs and the sample bucket policy.
Sam (SRE): I’ll join — I’ll also prepare a short perf slide showing the caching impact.
Maya (CS): Perfect. One more thing — tagging renewal risk: I’d mark this as Yellow (watch) because they’re engaged and make the changes, but the proxy latency + initial cost spike are the two signals. I’ll add to their account health card.
Ruth (Bridgefold): Thanks Maya. If we can get the proxy change and KMS done this week we’ll feel much better ahead of renewals.
deploy-bot: Deployment note — privnet-agent v2.3.1 was applied to bridgefold-prod at 1711207200 (no errors). :robot_face:
Maya (CS): Great, bot. After the Thursday runbook we should do a short follow-up next Monday to confirm metrics (latency + cost) are trending down.
Sam (SRE): Agreed. I’ll create a quick dashboard and share the URL in the runbook.
Maya (CS): Thanks everyone — I’ll capture the notes and update the Bridgefold onboarding card. If anything blocks Ruth, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
